notes: Hooked (entry 0xae8900, CRC 0x08115638, not in-game tested). Same shape as GetCachedServiceObjectB (0x9c5baa) and the CachedServiceGetter template, but the cached value is the result of slot 5 on the holder, not the holder itself. ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced: when the query or slot 5 throws, the original does not release the holder (its frame has one unwind state that does not call ScopedRef::ReleaseObject), so the reference leaks; the first version of the replacement released it and the test caught the difference (1 vs 2 calls). With no service object the original dereferences a null holder (access violation); the replacement does the same and the tests don't cover it. 200 cases: cache hit, cache miss, null and non-null slot 5 values, throwing query; compared on return value, cache global, throw and the call log.
